The '''Argazdan Redoubt''' was an area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz sector]] within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that was claimed by [[Argazdan/Legends|Argazdan]] religious fundamentalists known as the [[Myrialites]]. It lasted only the duration of the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]] which spanned three centuries from [[3970 BBY]] to [[3670 BBY]].

==History==
The [[Myrialites]] were a radical sect within [[Vianism]] which believed in forcing others to serve their deity [[Via]]. Regarding the secular [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as faithless and corrupt, the Myrialites under Provisional Governor [[Myrial]] staged an uprising in the Kanz Sector during the [[Old Sith Wars]]. They seceeded from the Republic and established the independent Argazdan Redoubt. Myrialites forces invaded and occupied other worlds and systems within the Kanz sector.

When the [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdians]] of [[Lorrd/Legends|Lorrd]] joined forces with the [[Amaltanna/Legends|Amaltannan]] resistance in a rebellion, the Myrialites enslaved the Lorrdians. Forbidden to speak, the Lorrdians developed another form of communication known as [[kinetic communication]] which involved subtle body gestures. With the Republic preoccupied with the [[Old Sith Wars]] and the [[Great Galactic War]], neither the Republic or the allied [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] moved against the Argazdan Redoubt for three centuries.

Around [[3670 BBY]], a Lorrdian [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]] was able to muster enough support in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] for military intervention against the Argazdans. Despite the dogged resistance of the Myrialites under [[Argazdan Regent|Regent]] [[Torphceris]], Republic and Jedi forces succeeded in liberating the Kanz sector especially Lorrd which fell after fierce fighting.

With the Myrialites defeat, the Argazdan Redoubt was re-integrated into the Republic. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], most Argazdans regarded the actions of the Myrialites with shame. One notable exception was [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Raygar]] who donned the robes of an Argazdan slave master during a performance at the [[Performance Square]] on Lorrd much to the outrage of Lorrdians and Argazdans alike.
